label: Rival: two distinct NECESSARY_2 beings, each a possible cause of every other being
paraphrase: Rival (modal ditheism), analyst formulation: there are two distinct beings a and b, each necessary at w (exists at every accessible world, NECESSARY_2) and each, at every world accessible from w, a possible cause of every other being existing there (OtherDirectedPotentialCause). It is the exact negation of STMT-NO-DISTINCT-NECESSARY-POTENTIAL-CAUSERS (RivalNegations in the batch controls).
